ape.reason: Discovery, ranking and synthesis prose ports cleanly. Its Claude Workflow dispatch mechanics do not exist on either target, so they are replaced by per-platform dispatch prose in build/overrides/ape/.

claude-tuneup.reason: Its entire subject is Claude Code's own settings.json files, permission-rule syntax and transcript store. There is no equivalent surface on either target to port it to, so generating it would produce a command that cannot do its job.

elephant-goldfish.reason: Proof plugin for the generator. Script-backed but platform-neutral: the judge, state resolver and renderer are ordinary shell/Python invoked through the plugin-root placeholder, and its two SKILL.md files map directly onto Agy skills.

imps.reason: The orchestration prose ports, but the Claude Workflow script that drives it does not run on either target; per-platform dispatch backends and their prose come from build/overrides/imps/.

offload-sidecar.reason: Ships no command, agent or skill files — it is an MCP server plus a Python entrypoint. Nothing to generate; per-platform registration is documented in its README instead (Agy mcp_config.json shape from docs/platform-matrix.md Item 10, environment passthrough key from the PR 2 re-verification token ENV_PASSTHROUGH).

prompt-builder.reason: Single self-contained command with no harness dependency beyond the bundled audit logger; the only platform-specific content is the audit-log invocation path.
